title: quassia pohliana
intro: Quassia pohliana, commonly known as Quassia, is a tropical plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family, native to Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, fever reduction, and relieving respiratory problems. Quassia is known for its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, as well as its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve nausea. The bioactive constituents of Quassia pohliana include quassin, quassinone, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
